parts.style: warm, gentle, calm, settling into a slow bedtime tone
parts.text: Find a comfortable position... and let your body settle into rest. <short pause> Close your eyes, if you haven't already. <short pause> Let your shoulders drop, away from your ears. <short pause> Take a slow breath in through your nose... and let it go. <short pause> Again, breathe in slowly... and release. <short pause> One more time. Breathing in God's peace... breathing out the tension of the day.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Tonight, you are laying down the day. <short pause> All the things you meant to finish. All the words you wish you'd said differently. All the tasks still waiting. <short pause> You are handing them back... to the One who holds time itself.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: There is a kind of work that belongs to daylight... and there is a rest that belongs to night. <short pause> God made both. <short pause> He set the sun to rise and set... the rhythm of waking and sleeping, working and resting. <short pause> This rhythm is his gift to you.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Take another slow breath. <short pause> And as you breathe out... let go of one thing you've been carrying. <short pause> It might be something you said today. Or something left undone. <short pause> Picture yourself opening your hands... and releasing it upward.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: God does not need you to hold the world together while you sleep. <short pause> He is awake. <short pause> He does not grow tired... or forget.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: There is a verse that speaks to this... a truth that cuts through our striving.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep. <short pause> Psalm one hundred twenty-seven, verse two. <long pause>

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Sleep is not something you must earn, by finishing everything first. <short pause> It is something God gives. <short pause> He gives it to his beloved. <short pause> You are his beloved.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Breathe in that truth now... slowly, and deeply. <short pause> Breathe out anything that tells you otherwise.

parts.style: soft, slow, soothing guided meditation voice
parts.text: Let your thoughts begin to slow... like leaves settling on still water. <short pause> If a worry surfaces, acknowledge it... and let it pass. <short pause> You can pick it up again tomorrow, if you need to. <short pause> Tonight, it does not belong to you.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Feel the weight of your body, sinking into the surface beneath you. <short pause> Notice the quiet around you. <short pause> This is the space God has made for you to rest.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: You do not have to do anything else. <short pause> You do not have to be anything else. <short pause> You are held. <short pause> Take one more slow breath... drawing in rest... releasing the day.

parts.style: prayerful, hushed, very slow, a gentle blessing
parts.text: And now, receive this blessing. <short pause> May the Lord give you sleep... not because you have earned it, but because you are loved. <short pause> May you rest in the knowledge that he is near... that he watches over you... and that the work of holding all things together has never been yours to carry. <short pause> May you wake tomorrow with strength that comes not from your own striving, but from his grace.
